_about: Pindar in English, translator per title. Ernest Myers, The Extant Odes (1874), clean Gutenberg. Dawson W. Turner's literal prose (Bohn, 1852) with Abraham Moore's metrical version appended, raw IA OCR (1872 reprint, the cleaner scan). Moore's Olympic and Pythian odes also exist as a c1903 Boston reprint; not taken, it duplicates the Bohn appendix. Also: F. A. Paley's prose (1868) and C. A. Wheelwright's verse (Valpy, 1830), raw IA OCR. Cary's Pindar (1833) is on lane C's cary shelf: cross-referenced, not fetched (a duplicate row added here on 2026-10-03 was withdrawn on review).

pindar-turner-moore: The Odes of Pindar, literally translated into English prose (Bohn; 1872 printing)
tr. Dawson W. Turner (prose) and Abraham Moore (verse)
pindar-west-1749: Odes of Pindar, with several other pieces in prose and verse, with a dissertation on the Olympick games (London, 1749)
pindar-laurent-prose-1824: The Odes of Pindar in English Prose, with West's Dissertation on the Olympic Games (Oxford: Munday and Slatter, 1824), 2 vols. in one scan
tr. Peter Edmund Laurent per the catalogue (not named on the title page)
pindar-paley-1868: The Odes of Pindar translated into English Prose, with brief explanatory notes and a preface (London: Williams and Norgate, 1868)
pindar-wheelwright-1830: Pindar, translated (London: A. J. Valpy for Colburn and Bentley, 1830)

_excluded.Sandys, Loeb Pindar (1915): US PD by date but Greek facing; pending, like the other Loebs
_excluded.odespindar00conggoog: 1852 first printing of the Turner/Moore Bohn; lower OCR quality than the 1872 reprint (clean-word 0.835 vs 0.872)
_excluded.olympicpythianod00pindiala: Moore's verse alone, c1903 reprint; duplicates the Bohn appendix

_translator_unchecked.pindar-west-1749: the long-s OCR never prints Gilbert West's name; 'west' alone is a common word and proves nothing
_translator_unchecked.pindar-laurent-prose-1824: attributed by the catalogue; the title page names no translator
_translator_unchecked.pindar-paley-1868: title page OCRs the name as 'F. A. PA LET, M.A., editor and translator of Aeschylus' (Williams and Norgate, 1868); the claim is not matched as written

_held.pindar-cary-1833: IA pindarinenglish00carygoog is already held on pipeline/cary_shelf.json (lane C) as cary-pindar; not refetched here
